name: Plectra Spectre
source:
Nadia Svara is an unemployed guitarist who lives alone in a cramped apartment. She used to work in a band, but was unable to keep it together, and blames herself for the way it fell apart.

Now at rock bottom, it's up to her to pick up the pieces. Can Nadia live a happy life again?

[From [url=https://violetbooks.itch.io/plectra-spectre]itch.io[/url]]
